items.quote: The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me
items.actor: The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob

items.quote: I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt
items.claim: God visited Israel and witnessed what was done to them in Egypt

items.quote: I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey
items.claim: God promised to bring Israel from Egypt to the land of Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey
items.place: Egypt; the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites
